newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Foshan Lighting 96 net hits 176mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Foshan Lighting 96 net hits 176mln yuan.

text.p: Foshan Lighting and Electrical Co Ltd chalked up net 1996 profit of 175.63 million yuan, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Thursday.
Earnings per share were 0.64 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 399.54 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
The company posted net profits of 170.24 million yuan on turnover of 547.19 million yuan based on international accounting standards in 1995, the company's 1995 reports said.
Under Chinese standards, it recorded net profit of 169.44 million yuan on turnover of 487.94 million in 1995, the report said.
The firm proposed a cash payment of 0.477 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Friday morning, to resume in the afternoon, it said.
